_comment: Hardware wiring for MOE and its GSE, for the --driver=stand composite driver.
Pass it with --hardware-config=config/hardware-moe.json; the startup
window does this for you when MOE is the chosen stand.
*** PROVISIONAL. The DC channel order is not decided yet. ***
Valve channels (valves[].channel in config/moe.json) are placeholders
numbered in P&ID order: DC1-DC8 are the vehicle, DC9-DC15 the GSE.
Change the channel on the valve in moe.json AND the dcChannels entry
below together once the harness is built, then verify each one the way
Draco's were: actuate from GC and watch which channel draws current.
CHANNEL COUNT. The PANDA addresses channels 1-12 and Draco's board has
current sense on DC1-DC11 only. MOE has 15 actuated valves, so as
numbered here GND-GN2-VENT (DC12), GN2-QD-CTRL (DC13), LOX-QD-CTRL
(DC14) and GND-PNEU-VENT (DC15) have no output on that board: commands
to DC13-DC15 are refused, and DC12 goes to a channel with nothing on it.
They need a second output board (route them with valveDevice) or a
larger PANDA before the GSE can be run from GC.
PT channels are one per transducer on the NI-9208, pt0-pt11, in the
order the sensors appear in moe.json. maxPsi is a placeholder sized to
each line (5000 psi class for GN2, 1500 for propellant, 500 for
pneumatics and fill lines); set it from the installed transducers.
_stand: Which stand this wiring belongs to. Checked against meta.standName in the stand config at startup.

_dcChannels: Wire position in the board's 's' line -> the channel it senses. The
positions are the PANDA's own (two reversed banks: DC8..DC1, then an
empty DC12 slot, then DC11..DC9 -- see config/hardware.json), so they
carry over from Draco; only the valve on each channel is MOE's, and
that follows the placeholder channel numbers in moe.json.
